In figure 3.56, in a circle with centre O, length of chord AB is equal to the radius of the circle. Find measure of each of the following.

(1) \(\angle AOB\)

(2) \(\angle ACB\)

(3) arc AB

(4) arc ACB.

In figure 3.57, \(\square\)PQRS is cyclic. side PQ \(\cong\) side RQ. \(\angle PSR = 110^\circ\), Find-

(1) measure of \(\angle PQR\)

(2) \(m(\text{arc PQR})\)

(3) \(m(\text{arc QR})\)

(4) measure of \(\angle PRQ\)
\(\square\)MRPN is cyclic, \(\angle R = (5x - 13)^\circ\), \(\angle N = (4x + 4)^\circ\). Find measures of \(\angle R\) and \(\angle N\).
In figure 3.58, seg RS is a diameter of the circle with centre O. Point T lies in the exterior of the circle. Prove that \(\angle RTS\) is an acute angle.
Prove that, any rectangle is a cyclic quadrilateral.

In figure 3.59, altitudes YZ and XT of \(\triangle WXY\) intersect at P. Prove that,

(1) \(\square\)WZPT is cyclic.

(2) Points X, Z, T, Y are concyclic.
In figure 3.60, \(m(\text{arc NS}) = 125^\circ\), \(m(\text{arc EF}) = 37^\circ\), find the measure \(\angle NMS\).
In figure 3.61, chords AC and DE intersect at B. If \(\angle ABE = 108^\circ\), \(m(\text{arc AE}) = 95^\circ\), find \(m(\text{arc DC})\).
